tools.name: search_endpoints
tools.description: Find data endpoints by keywords (English or Chinese) and platform. Each result has the endpoint id to pass to call_endpoint, what it returns, the price per record and its parameters. Without query and platform it lists every platform with its number of endpoints. Free, no key needed.

tools.name: call_endpoint
tools.description: Fetch live public data from one endpoint. Use search_endpoints first to get the endpoint id and its parameters. The answer is { data, cursor, meta }: meta.charged_usd is what this call was charged and meta.balance_usd what is left. Charged per record returned; errors on our side are not charged. Nee

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: The account's balance in USD: paid, trial credit, and what open requests are holding. Free. Needs an API key.
